summary: Portfolio Import feature tested: 32 backend tests (27 unit + 5 live API) all pass. Frontend portfolio tab loads correctly with ImportHoldings component rendered and import button visible. One minor cosmetic bug found: Unicode escape sequences in JSX text content render literally.

ui_bugs.issue: Unicode escape sequences in JSX text content render as literals instead of characters. e.g. '\u00b7' shows as '\u00b7' not '·', '\u2713' shows as '\u2713' not '✓', '\u2192' shows as '\u2192' not '→', '\u00d7' shows as '\u00d7' not '×'. Lines 109, 115, 132, 136, 140, 141 of ImportHoldings.tsx. Fix: wrap in JS expressions {'·'} or use the actual Unicode character directly.

action_items: Fix Unicode escape sequences in JSX text content in ImportHoldings.tsx (lines 109, 115, 132, 136, 140, 141) — wrap in JS expressions e.g. {'·'} or use actual characters · ✓ → × —
